shots.vo: Baby Krishna steals butter while Yashoda watches.
shots.prompt: inside a mud-walled village kitchen in Gokul at dawn, baby Krishna sits on the floor beside a tipped clay pot, his hands full of white butter, butter on his cheeks, while his mother Yashoda in a red cotton saree stands in the doorway, hands on hips, smiling, warm sunlight through a small window, clay pots and a churning rod

shots.vo: Vishnu rests on the serpent Shesha.
shots.prompt: Lord Vishnu reclines on the coiled serpent Shesha, its many hooded heads spread above him like a canopy, floating on a calm cosmic ocean under a starlit sky, Goddess Lakshmi in a red silk saree sits at his feet, soft golden light

Lord Hanuman flies through a stormy night sky holding an entire green mountain on his raised right palm, his mace in the other hand, his face determined, lightning behind him, the forested mountain lit by a soft divine glow

Lord Shiva sits cross-legged in deep meditation on a snow-covered ledge of Mount Kailash, a cobra around his neck, the crescent moon in his matted hair, a trident planted beside him, mist and first light over the Himalayan peaks
